## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky38

- Skip absolute-path construction when prefetching ordinary local inputs, while preserving downloads for rewound outputs, tree artifacts, and resolved symlinks ([#31351](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31351)).
- Encode remote-execution digest hashes directly as hexadecimal bytes, avoiding intermediate strings and repeated UTF-8 encoding ([#31352](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31352)).
- Replace the regex used to classify profiled VFS operations with a literal substring check ([#31353](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31353)).
- Avoid temporary path strings when computing Merkle-tree parent directories and common prefixes ([#31354](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31354)).
- Reuse JSON formatting styles and buffer character writes in the trace-profile writer ([#31355](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31355)).
- Encode worker-input digests without intermediate byte copies or strings, using the shared digest helper ([#31356](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31356)).
- Reuse a thread-local buffer when computing file digests, with protection against reentrant digest calls ([#31357](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31357)).
- Parse `/proc/meminfo` fields lazily instead of constructing a map of every entry ([#31358](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31358)).

### Validation

All seven targeted test suites passed on non-root Linux remote execution: remote operations, remote-execution integration, Merkle trees, VFS, profiling, workers, and Unix utilities. Added regressions cover skipping path construction for local inputs and downloading rewound outputs with local metadata. Digest encodings and wire formats are unchanged.

### Prebuilts

Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64 are built and version-checked before immutable publication, with SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance records. Existing release tags and assets are preserved.
